description.text: Duration 3 years Degree Warded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Cartography and Geography Information System by Yangtze University

duration.text: The Cartography and Geography Information System at Yangtze University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for duration of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6. Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3. Applicants must be in good health
